comparisons.name: trackpad-end-light
comparisons.description: Right end of the separator above the sliders of the Trackpad pane, on its box, Aqua: the end is square. A 12 x 11 pt crop close around the end, counted at a colour distance of 0.01, because the line is only 23 levels from its background: the default distance counts none of it, and 0.02 not the two half-covered pixels of a rounded end. At 0.01 six of the 528 pixels at 2x differ as built (the line is one level off on this box) and ten with a rounded end, which the 2x budget refuses; at 1x a rounded end is not seen.

comparisons.name: trackpad-end-dark
comparisons.description: Right end of the separator above the sliders of the Trackpad pane, on its box, Dark Aqua: the end is square. Crop and colour distance as in trackpad-end-light.
